definition: a state of confusion and untidiness
description: Three young men sit at a white table wearing pink sleep masks over their eyes, with a big clear plastic box in front of them. The one on the left lifts a smaller tub and tips a thick stream of bright green slime over the head of the man in the middle. The slime coats his hair and face and hangs down in long strings into the box below. He gropes about, lifts a whole stretched sheet of slime up over his head, and the box, the table and all three of them end up smeared with green goo while the other two shake with laughter.

en.question: What are the three men making?

de.answer: Sie richten mit Schleim ein Chaos an.
de.question: Was richten die drei Männer an?

es.answer: Están haciendo un desastre con slime.
es.question: ¿Qué están haciendo los tres hombres?

fr.answer: Ils salissent tout avec du slime.
fr.question: Que font les trois hommes ?
